name: Pricing page refresh
request: Refresh our pricing page from what competitors charge. Let me OK anything before it goes live.

steps.prompt:
Find the current prices of the 9 competitors in our Notion list “Competitors”.

For each plan, write down the plan name, the monthly price, and what is included. Put it all in the Notion table “Competitor pricing”.

Flag anything that changed since last month.

Using the “Competitor pricing” table, draft our new pricing page: a headline, three plan cards and a short FAQ.

Keep our current prices. Write plainly, no hype. Match the layout of the Figma frame “Pricing / v3”.
Read the last 14 customer interview notes in Notion. Pull out short quotes about price and value, and group them by theme so the Writer can use them on the page.

steps.asks: wants to publish the pricing page
steps.prompt:
Check every price on the draft against the “Competitor pricing” table and our own price list. Fix typos.

When it is right, publish the page and post a two-line summary in #launches on Slack.
